words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: He wields his knowledge to solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他运用自己的知识来解决问题。
words.en: To wield something means to hold and use it, especially as a weapon or tool. It can also mean to have and be able to use power or influence.

words.ex: The bottle has a cork stopper.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子有一个软木塞。
words.en: Cork is a light, porous material obtained from the bark of the cork oak tree, used especially for making stoppers for bottles.

words.tr:
n. 誓言；誓约
v. 发誓；起誓
words.ex: He made a vow to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓戒烟。
words.en: A vow is a serious promise or decision to do something.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.ex: The fallen tree obstructs the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树挡住了道路。
words.en: If something obstructs a road or path, it blocks it, stopping people or vehicles from getting past.

words.ex: The army used artillery to attack the enemy base.
words.ex_cn: 军队用火炮攻击了敌方基地。
words.en: Artillery refers to large-caliber guns used in warfare on land.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.ex: The trip is contingent on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行取决于天气情况。
words.en: A contingent event or situation depends on something else in order to happen or exist.

words.tr: v. 报（某事）之仇；为（某人）报仇
words.ex: He wants to avenge his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为弟弟的死报仇。
words.en: To avenge someone means to harm or punish someone who has harmed them or someone they care about.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: The hikers struggled across the rough terrain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者艰难地穿越了崎岖的地形。
words.en: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: He made a plea for help.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助。
words.en: A plea is a request or an appeal made in an urgent or emotional manner, or a statement made by someone in a court of law in which they say whether they are guilty of a crime or not.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.tr:
n. 钉；支柱
v. 钉（木桩等）以固定；限定
words.ex: He hung the hat on a peg.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子挂在了一个钉子上。
words.en: A peg is a small device, usually made of wood or metal, that is used to fasten things or to hang things on.

words.tr:
v. 屠杀 
n. 大屠杀
words.ex: The soldiers committed a massacre in the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在村庄里进行了大屠杀。
words.en: The indiscriminate killing of a large number of people.

words.ex: He showed courtesy by holding the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他为别人扶着门，表现得很礼貌。
words.en: Courtesy is polite behavior, or a polite action or remark.

words.ex: The police will interrogate the suspect tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 警察明天会审问嫌疑人。
words.en: To interrogate someone means to ask them a lot of questions for a long time in order to get information, sometimes using threats.

words.tr: n. 中士；巡佐；军士；警官
words.ex: The sergeant gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军士向士兵们下达了命令。
words.en: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer in the army or marines ranking above a corporal and below a lieutenant, or a police officer ranking below an inspector.

words.ex: He carved a big pumpkin for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 他为万圣节雕刻了一个大南瓜。
words.en: A pumpkin is a large, round, orange vegetable with a thick skin.

words.ex: They walked abreast down the street.
words.ex_cn: 他们并肩走在街上。
words.en: If people or things are abreast, they are lined up next to each other, side by side, and often facing the same direction.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.tr: adj. 多边的；多国参加的
words.ex: The multilateral agreement helped many countries work together.
words.ex_cn: 这个多边协议帮助许多国家共同合作。
words.en: Involving or agreed upon by three or more parties, especially the governments of different countries.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: The car depreciates every year.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车每年都会贬值。
words.en: If something such as a currency depreciates or if something depreciates it, it loses some of its original value.

words.ex: Blue jeans are in vogue this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: If something is in vogue, it is very popular and fashionable.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.tr: v. 使屈辱；使丢脸；使蒙羞
words.ex: He tried to humiliate her in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在全班面前羞辱她。
words.en: To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed or stupid, especially in front of other people.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: He hired a solicitor to help with his house sale.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名事务律师来帮助处理他的房屋出售。
words.en: A solicitor is a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares legal documents, especially in England.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.ex: The fire brigade arrived quickly.
words.ex_cn: 消防队很快就到了。
words.en: A brigade is a large unit of an army, typically consisting of three or more battalions and forming part of a division.

words.ex: The city hosted an exposition last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年夏天举办了一场博览会。
words.en: An exposition is a detailed explanation or description of an idea or theory. It can also refer to a large public exhibition of art or trade goods.

words.ex: The clearance of trash improved the park's appearance.
words.ex_cn: 清理垃圾改善了公园的外观。
words.en: Clearance refers to the process of removing or getting rid of something, or the space that is needed for one thing to move past another. It can also refer to the permission given for something to happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 回想
v. 回想
words.ex: In retrospect, I should have studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 回顾过去，我本该更努力学习的。
words.en: When you consider something in retrospect, you think about it afterwards, and often have a different opinion about it from the one that you had at the time.

words.ex: Telecommunications connect people across the world.
words.ex_cn: 电信连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic means, such as radio, telephone, television, and the internet.

words.tr:
n. 伪装；伪装物；
v. 伪装；掩饰；
words.ex: He wore a hat and glasses as a disguise.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了帽子和眼镜作为伪装。
words.en: To disguise means to change your appearance or behavior so that people will not recognize you, or to make something seem different from what it really is.

words.ex: The bird flew aloft above the trees.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在树顶上方高飞。
words.en: If something is aloft, it is in the air or off the ground.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.tr: v. 先占；使全神贯注；占据…的思想
words.ex: The old man preoccupies the best seat in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人先占了公园里最好的座位。
words.en: If something is preoccupying you, you are thinking about it a lot or it is occupying your attention.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.tr:
n. 筛子；滤器
v. 筛；滤
words.ex: He used a sieve to separate sand from pebbles.
words.ex_cn: 他用筛子把沙子和石子分开。
words.en: A sieve is a tool consisting of a wire or plastic mesh held in a frame, used for separating solids from liquids or larger particles from smaller ones.

words.ex: The baby was sleeping in the cradle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在吊架里睡觉。
words.en: A cradle is a small bed for a baby, which can be rocked from side to side. It can also refer to the place or period in which something begins or is developed.

words.tr:
v. 逝去；过去
n. （光阴）逝去
words.ex: Two hours elapsed while he waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时，两个小时过去了。
words.en: If time elapses, it passes.

words.ex: The small boat docked at the inlet.
words.ex_cn: 小船停靠在小水湾。
words.en: An inlet is a narrow strip of water that leads from a sea or lake into the land or between islands.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr: adj. 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；
words.ex: He has a muscular arm from lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他因为举重而拥有强壮的手臂。
words.en: Relating to or affecting the muscles; having well-developed muscles.

words.tr:
n. 降落伞
v. 跳伞；用降落伞空投
words.ex: He jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.
words.ex_cn: 他从飞机上跳下并打开了降落伞。
words.en: A parachute is a device used to slow the motion of an object through an atmosphere by creating drag.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.ex: The hikers walked along the ridge of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者沿着山脊行走。
words.en: A ridge is a long, narrow elevation of land, or a raised strip.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.tr: v. 使相混；使联结；交际
words.ex: He mingled the two colors to make a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他把两种颜色混合在一起，创造出一种新颜色。
words.en: If things such as sounds, smells, or feelings mingle, they mix or combine with each other, or if people mingle, they talk to each other at a social event.

words.ex: He used a cliche to describe the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个陈词滥调来形容日落。
words.en: A cliché is an idea or phrase that has been used so much that it is no longer interesting or effective.

words.tr: adj. 精明的；敏锐的；机灵的；
words.ex: He made a shrewd decision to buy the house low.
words.ex_cn: 他精明地决定低价买下这栋房子。
words.en: A shrewd person is able to understand and judge a situation quickly and to use this understanding to their own advantage.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.tr: adj. 断断续续的；间歇的
words.ex: The rain is intermittent today.
words.ex_cn: 今天雨断断续续地下。
words.en: Something that is intermittent happens occasionally rather than continuously.

words.ex: The school will curtail recess time during exams.
words.ex_cn: 学校在考试期间将缩短课间休息时间。
words.en: If you curtail something, you reduce or limit it.

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.ex: She wore a white veil on her wedding day.
words.ex_cn: 她在婚礼那天戴了一条白色的面纱。
words.en: A veil is a piece of thin soft cloth that women sometimes wear over their heads and which can also cover their face.

words.tr:
n. 懦夫；胆小鬼；胆怯者
adj. 胆小的；怯懦的
words.ex: He was a coward and ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他是个懦夫，逃跑了。
words.en: A coward is someone who is easily frightened and avoids dangerous or difficult situations.

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: He practices Buddhism every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上修行佛教。
words.en: Buddhism is a religion and philosophy based on the teachings of the Buddha, emphasizing the elimination of suffering and the attainment of enlightenment.

words.tr:
n. 抒情诗；歌词
adj. 抒情的
words.ex: He wrote a lyric about the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于日落的抒情诗。
words.en: Lyric refers to the words of a song, especially a popular song, or to a short poem that expresses personal feelings and thoughts.

words.ex: The car drove under the overpass.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从立交桥下开过。
words.en: An overpass is a bridge that carries one road or railway line over another.

words.tr: n. 势利小人；谄上欺下的人；恃才傲物的人
words.ex: He acts like a snob because he only likes expensive things.
words.ex_cn: 他只喜欢昂贵的东西，所以表现得像个势利小人。
words.en: A snob is someone who thinks they are better than other people because they are more intelligent, more cultured, or of a higher social class.

words.ex: The joy was transient, like a brief smile.
words.ex_cn: 这种快乐是短暂的，像一个短暂的微笑。
words.en: If you describe something as transient, you mean that it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: He expressed dissent about the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了异议。
words.en: Dissent is strong disagreement or dissatisfaction with a decision or opinion, especially one that is supported by most people or by people in authority.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.ex: The tanker carried oil across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘油轮将石油运过了大海。
words.en: A tanker is a ship, airplane, or truck designed to carry liquids, especially oil, in large quantities.

words.ex: He affirm that the plan will work.
words.ex_cn: 他断言这个计划会成功。
words.en: If you affirm that something is true or that something exists, you state firmly and publicly that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.tr:
adj. 愉快的；快乐的
v. 开玩笑；作乐
adv. 非常；很
words.ex: He is jolly at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上很快乐。
words.en: If you describe someone as jolly, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.ex: He flung his hat on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子扔在椅子上。
words.en: To throw something quickly and carelessly; to move or do something suddenly and energetically.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；（使）联合；（使）成一体；
words.ex: The two teams decided to unify their efforts.
words.ex_cn: 这两个团队决定统一他们的努力。
words.en: To unify means to make or become united, uniform, or whole.

words.ex: This old phone is an analogue of the new smartphone.
words.ex_cn: 这部旧手机是这款智能手机的类似物。
words.en: Something that is similar to another thing in design, origin, use, etc., but not exactly the same.

words.ex: He bought new stationery for school.
words.ex_cn: 他为学校买了新的文具。
words.en: Stationery refers to the materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.tr:
v. 闪烁；隐约闪现
n. 亮光；闪光
words.ex: The sun gleams on the water.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在水面上，闪闪发亮。
words.en: A gleam is a small, bright light, especially one that shines for a short time.

words.ex: The computer uses a buffer to store data temporarily.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用缓冲区临时存储数据。
words.en: A buffer is something that prevents something else from being harmed or that reduces the impact of something.

words.ex: The police will detain the suspect for questioning.
words.ex_cn: 警察将扣留嫌疑人进行审问。
words.en: If someone is detained, they are officially held in a place, especially a prison, and are not allowed to leave.

words.ex: The synonym of 'happy' is 'glad'.
words.ex_cn: ‘happy’的同义词是‘glad’。
words.en: A synonym is a word or phrase that means exactly or nearly the same as another word or phrase in the same language.

words.ex: Children hunt eggs on Easter morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在复活节早上找鸡蛋。
words.en: Easter is a Christian festival and holiday celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ on the third day after his crucifixion at Calvary as described in the New Testament.

words.tr: adj. 母亲的；母性的；母系的；
words.ex: Her maternal love kept the family strong.
words.ex_cn: 她的母爱让家庭保持坚强。
words.en: Maternal feelings or actions are typical of a kind, loving mother.

words.ex: The butterfly has perfect symmetry.
words.ex_cn: 这只蝴蝶有完美的对称性。
words.en: Symmetry is the quality of being made up of exactly similar parts facing each other or around an axis.

words.tr:
v. （使）回旋；（使）旋转
n. 一连串的事；混乱；尝试
words.ex: The wind makes the leaves whirl around.
words.ex_cn: 风让树叶旋转飞舞。
words.en: To move or cause to move rapidly around and around.

words.ex: They had a big banquet after the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会。
words.en: A banquet is a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honor of someone.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.ex: The chair is stationary and does not move.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子是固定的，不会移动。
words.en: not moving or not intended to be moved

words.tr:
v. 眨眼；使眼色；闪烁
n. 眨眼；眼色；瞬间
words.ex: He winked at me to show he was joking.
words.ex_cn: 他朝我眨了眨眼，表示他在开玩笑。
words.en: If you wink at someone, you look towards them and close one eye very briefly, usually as a signal that something is a joke or a secret.

words.tr: adj. 一丝不苟的；缜密的
words.ex: He is meticulous about checking his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细检查作业。
words.en: If you describe someone as meticulous, you mean that they do things very carefully and with great attention to detail.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.tr: adj. 与选举有关的；选举的
words.ex: He won the electoral vote by a small margin.
words.ex_cn: 他以微弱优势赢得了选举人票。
words.en: Relating to elections or electors.

words.tr: n. 联邦；共和国；联合体；
words.ex: Australia is a member of the Commonwealth.
words.ex_cn: 澳大利亚是联邦的成员。
words.en: A commonwealth is a traditional English term for a political community founded for the common good. Historically, it has been synonymous with 'republic'.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: The timid boy whispered his answer.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩小声说出了他的答案。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior or actions as timid, you are criticizing them for being too cautious or slow to act, because they are nervous about the possible consequences of their actions.

words.ex: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 旧墙在雨后开始坍塌。
words.en: If something crumbles, or if you crumble it, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.tr:
adj. 连续的；连环的
n. 连续剧；连载小说
words.ex: He watched the serial episodes every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上观看连续的剧集。
words.en: A serial is a story or play that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts at fixed times, or a story that is published in a magazine or newspaper in several parts.

words.ex: His greed made him steal money from his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他的贪婪让他偷了朋友的钱。
words.en: Greed is the desire to have more of something, such as food or money, than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: The two countries signed a protocol to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项停止战争的协议。
words.en: A protocol is a set of rules or a system of rules about the correct way to act in formal situations.

words.ex: There is little intercourse between the two villages.
words.ex_cn: 这两个村庄之间很少交往。
words.en: Intercourse refers to communication or dealings between individuals or groups, or sexual activity between people.

words.tr: n. 迷信；迷信观念（或思想）；
words.ex: He avoids walking under ladders because of superstition.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迷信而不愿从梯子下走过。
words.en: A superstition is a belief or practice resulting from ignorance, fear of the unknown, trust in magic or chance, or a false conception of causation.

words.tr:
v. 咯咯地笑
n. 咯咯笑；趣事
words.ex: The children giggle when they see the clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到小丑时咯咯笑。
words.en: To laugh in a silly, often high-pitched way, especially in a nervous or embarrassed manner.

words.ex: The pope speaks to millions of people every year.
words.ex_cn: 教皇每年向数百万人讲话。
words.en: The Pope is the bishop of Rome and the leader of the worldwide Catholic Church.

words.ex: He sent a message through a messenger.
words.ex_cn: 他通过信使发送了一条消息。
words.en: A messenger is someone who carries messages from one person to another.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.ex: The statesman spoke wisely to calm the nation.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家明智地讲话以安抚国家。
words.en: A statesman is a respected political leader or figure, especially one who has had a long and successful career in politics.

words.ex: The country made a unilateral decision to close the border.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家单方面决定关闭边境。
words.en: Involving only one group or country.

words.ex: The boat stops at the wharf near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 船停在海边的码头。
words.en: A wharf is a platform built out into the water where ships can be tied up and goods can be loaded or unloaded.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.ex: He despises lying.
words.ex_cn: 他鄙视撒谎。
words.en: If you despise something or someone, you dislike them and have a very low opinion of them.

words.tr: v. 暗指；（间接）提到；影射
words.ex: He alluded to the problem without naming it.
words.ex_cn: 他暗示了这个问题，但没有点明。
words.en: To allude to something means to mention it in an indirect way.

words.ex: He rowed the boat with an oar.
words.ex_cn: 他用桨划船。
words.en: An oar is a long pole with a wide, flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.tr: v. 蒸馏；用蒸馏法提取；蒸馏出；提炼
words.ex: They distill water to remove impurities.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过蒸馏去除水中的杂质。
words.en: To distill a liquid means to purify it by heating it until it becomes a gas and then cooling it so that it becomes a liquid again. This process can also be used to extract the essential elements or meanings from something.

words.tr:
v. 振翼；颤动；飘动；挥动
n. 鼓翼；飘扬；激动不安
words.ex: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.tr: n. 公牛；大型雄性动物；胡扯；废话
words.ex: The bull charged at the matador.
words.ex_cn: 公牛冲向了斗牛士。
words.en: A bull is a male animal of the cattle family, or a male elephant, whale, or other large animal. In finance, a bull is someone who buys shares in the expectation that their value will rise.

words.tr:
v. 跛行；蹒跚；瘸着走
adj. 无力的；无生气的
words.ex: He limps after hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路一瘸一拐。
words.en: If someone limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

words.ex: The study focuses on qualitative data, like people's feelings.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究关注定性数据，比如人们的感受。
words.en: relating to, measuring, or measured by the quality of something rather than its quantity.

words.ex: The turtle walks slowly on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟在沙子上慢慢走。
words.en: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell that lives in the sea or on land.

words.tr:
v. 口吃；结结巴巴地说
n. 口吃；结巴
words.ex: He stammers when he is nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他紧张时会结巴。
words.en: If someone stammers, they speak with difficulty, hesitating and repeating words or sounds.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.tr: adj. 雄辩的；有口才的；有说服力的
words.ex: He gave an eloquent speech at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上发表了富有感染力的演讲。
words.en: If you describe someone as eloquent, you mean that they are able to express their ideas and opinions well, so that other people understand them and are influenced by them.

words.tr: n. 使节；特使；外交使节；
words.ex: The envoy met the president to discuss peace.
words.ex_cn: 使节会见了总统以讨论和平事宜。
words.en: An envoy is a representative sent by one government or leader to another, especially in order to carry out a particular task or to negotiate.

words.ex: He is diligent in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都很勤奋地做作业。
words.en: Someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough.

words.tr:
n. 成分；
adj. 构成的；
words.ex: Sugar is a constituent of soda.
words.ex_cn: 糖是苏打水的一种成分。
words.en: A constituent is a part of a whole. In politics, a constituent is a person who is represented by an elected official.

words.tr:
v. 责备；指责
n. 责备；指责
words.ex: She reproached him for being late.
words.ex_cn: 她责备他迟到了。
words.en: To express disapproval or disappointment towards someone because of their actions or behavior.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.ex: He was beset by problems at work.
words.ex_cn: 他被工作中的问题困扰。
words.en: If someone or something is beset by problems or fears, they have many problems or fears which affect them severely.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.ex: She added bleach to the white shirt to make it brighter.
words.ex_cn: 她往白衬衫里加了漂白剂，让它更亮。
words.en: To bleach something means to make it white or pale by using a chemical or by exposing it to sunlight.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: The doctor tested his urine for infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检测了他的尿液是否有感染。
words.en: Urine is the liquid that you get rid of from your body when you go to the toilet.

words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.ex: The government used propaganda to influence people's opinions.
words.ex_cn: 政府使用宣传来影响人们的观点。
words.en: Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.

words.ex: He uses soap to cleanse his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: To cleanse something means to make it extremely clean, especially by using a special substance or process.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.ex: The smell repels insects.
words.ex_cn: 这种气味能击退昆虫。
words.en: If something repels you, it is so unpleasant or offensive that you want to avoid it or push it away.

words.tr: v. 倾倒；摇摇欲坠；将…推翻；使…跌倒
words.ex: The strong wind toppled the old tree.
words.ex_cn: 大风把那棵老树吹倒了。
words.en: If someone or something topples, or if someone or something topples them, they become unsteady or unstable and fall over.

words.tr:
v. 大步行走；跨一大步
n. 大步；步伐
words.ex: He takes a long stride when he walks.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时迈着大步。
words.en: To walk with long, decisive steps in a specified direction.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.tr:
n. 女同性恋者
adj. 女同性恋的
words.ex: She is a lesbian and loves her partner.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名女同性恋者，深爱着她的伴侣。
words.en: A lesbian is a woman who is sexually attracted to other women.

words.ex: He bought a quart of milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。
words.en: A quart is a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to two pints or approximately 1.14 liters.

words.ex: People congregate in the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 人们在周末聚集在公园里。
words.en: To congregate means to come together in a group or crowd.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.tr:
n. 斗篷；掩护物
v. 隐瞒；掩饰
words.ex: He wore a black cloak to hide his face.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色斗篷来遮住脸。
words.en: A cloak is a long, loose outer garment which is worn over other clothes, especially in cold weather. It can also refer to something that hides or covers another thing.

words.tr: v. 惠顾；资助；屈尊俯就
words.ex: He often patronizes the local bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他经常光顾这家本地面包店。
words.en: If someone patronizes you, they speak or behave towards you in a way which seems friendly, but which shows that they think they are superior to you in some way.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr:
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
v. 使麻木；使迟钝
words.ex: His fingers felt numb after being in the cold.
words.ex_cn: 他的手指在寒冷中变得麻木。
words.en: If a part of your body is numb, you cannot feel it, usually for a short time.

words.ex: The house has a small annex for storage.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个用于存放物品的小附属物。
words.en: To annex means to take control of a country, region, etc., especially by force; to add an area or region to a country, state, etc. : to take control of (a territory or place).

words.tr:
v. 呜咽；抽噎
n. 抽噎（声）；啜泣（声）
words.ex: The little girl sobbed after losing her toy.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在丢失玩具后哭了起来。
words.en: To cry noisily, taking in short breaths.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.tr:
n. 护送；护航；护卫
v. 护航；护送
words.ex: The army sent a convoy to protect the trucks.
words.ex_cn: 军队派出护送队保护卡车。
words.en: A convoy is a group of vehicles or ships traveling together, typically accompanied by armed troops, warships, or other vehicles for protection.

words.tr:
adj. 瘸的；跛的；站不住脚的；无说服力的
v. 变跛；瘸行
words.ex: The lame dog walked slowly on three legs.
words.ex_cn: 那只瘸狗用三条腿慢慢走。
words.en: If someone is lame, they are unable to walk properly because of damage to one or both of their legs. A lame excuse, explanation, etc. is one that is weak and difficult to believe.

words.ex: The obscene behavior shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这种可憎的行为让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: If you describe something as obscene, you mean it offends you because it relates to sex or violence in a way that you think is unpleasant and shocking.

words.ex: He used an analogy to explain how the heart works.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个类比来解释心脏是如何工作的。
words.en: If you make or draw an analogy between two things, you show that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He is the premier player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最优秀的球员。
words.en: The premier is the leader of the government in some countries, equivalent to a prime minister.

words.tr: adj. 能吃苦耐劳的；耐寒的；
words.ex: He is a hardy farmer who works in the field all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个能吃苦耐劳的农民，整天在田里干活。
words.en: Someone who is hardy is strong and able to cope with difficult conditions.

words.ex: The king's assassination shocked the whole country.
words.ex_cn: 国王的暗杀震惊了整个国家。
words.en: The act of killing someone important or famous, often for political reasons.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The old song is reminiscent of my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌让人想起我的童年。
words.en: If you say that one thing is reminiscent of another, you mean that it reminds you of it.

words.ex: He wears a helmet when he rides a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时戴头盔。
words.en: A helmet is a strong, hard hat which is worn to protect your head.

words.tr:
v. 给…打钩；发出滴嗒声；
n. 钩号；
words.ex: Please tick the box if you agree.
words.ex_cn: 如果你同意，请在方框里打钩。
words.en: The word 'tick' can refer to the sound a clock makes, a very short period of time, a mark used to indicate something, or a type of small insect. As a verb, it can mean to make a ticking sound or to mark something with a tick.

words.ex: Beware of the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当心那只狗。
words.en: to be cautious and alert to the dangers of.

words.ex: The engine has four cylinders.
words.ex_cn: 发动机有四个气缸。
words.en: A cylinder is a geometric figure with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross section.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.tr:
n. 栖枝；鲈鱼；
v. 栖息；处于（高处）；
words.ex: The bird sat on a perch near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在树旁的一根栖枝上。
words.en: A perch is a branch or rod where a bird rests or a high position where someone or something is located. As a verb, it means to rest or be located in a high position.

words.tr:
v. 虚张声势；唬人
n. 虚张声势；吓唬；峭壁
adj. 直率的
words.ex: He used a bluff to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他用虚张声势赢得了比赛。
words.en: If you bluff, you try to make someone believe that you will do something when you do not really intend to do it, or that you know something when you do not really know it.

words.ex: He flushes the toilet after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他用完厕所后冲水。
words.en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger. To flush a toilet means to cause water to pass through it in order to clean it.

words.tr:
n. 愚蠢的错误；失误
v. 犯愚蠢的错误；失误；跌跌撞撞地走
words.ex: He made a big blunder in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中犯了一个大错误。
words.en: A blunder is a stupid or careless mistake.

words.tr: adj. 不透明的；难懂的；晦涩的
words.ex: The glass is opaque, so I cannot see through it.
words.ex_cn: 这扇玻璃是不透明的，所以我看不到它后面的东西。
words.en: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

words.ex: The rotary switch turns on the light.
words.ex_cn: 旋转开关打开灯。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by rotation.

words.tr: v. 接着发生；因而产生
words.ex: The storm ended, and peace ensued.
words.ex_cn: 风暴结束后，和平随之而来。
words.en: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it.

words.tr: n. （身体或精神的）极度痛苦
words.ex: He felt deep anguish after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 失去狗后，他感到极度痛苦。
words.en: Anguish is extreme mental suffering or physical pain.

words.ex: He said it with sarcasm, even though he seemed happy.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话时带着讽刺，尽管他看起来很高兴。
words.en: Sarcasm is a sharp, bitter, or cutting expression or remark; a bitter gibe or taunt.

words.ex: He bought a warm pastry from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一个热乎乎的点心。
words.en: Pastry is a food made from flour, fat, and water that is mixed together, rolled flat, and baked in an oven. It is used as a base or covering for pies, tarts, and other dishes.

words.tr: adj. 无情的；冷酷的；残忍的；
words.ex: The ruthless boss fired employees without warning.
words.ex_cn: 这位无情的老板未经警告就解雇了员工。
words.en: If you say that someone is ruthless, you mean that you disapprove of them because they are very harsh or cruel, and will do anything that is necessary to achieve what they want.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: The teacher has a long tenure at the school.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师在学校有很长的任期。
words.en: The period during which an office is held; the status of holding one's position on a permanent basis.

words.tr:
n. 跨栏；障碍；难关
v. 越过障碍；克服
words.ex: He jumped over the hurdle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跳过了跨栏。
words.en: A hurdle is a problem or difficulty that you must deal with before you can achieve something.

words.ex: He felt deep grief after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Intense sorrow, especially caused by someone's death.

words.tr: n. 外交官；会耍手腕儿的人
words.ex: The diplomat met the president yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这位外交官昨天会见了总统。
words.en: A diplomat is a person who represents their country in a foreign country, managing political relations and negotiations.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.tr: v. 骚扰；烦扰；屡次侵扰
words.ex: He harasses his coworkers with loud jokes.
words.ex_cn: 他用大声的笑话骚扰他的同事。
words.en: If someone harasses you, they trouble or annoy you, for example by attacking you repeatedly or by causing you as many problems as they can.

words.ex: He faced his adversary in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 他在决赛中对阵对手。
words.en: An adversary is someone who you are competing with, or who is opposing you or what you are trying to do.

words.tr:
v. 费力地做；苦干；跋涉
n. 苦工；劳累的工作
words.ex: He toils in the field every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在田里辛苦劳作。
words.en: If you toil, you work very hard doing something that is difficult or tiring.

words.ex: The cows are grazing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛群正在草地上吃草。
words.en: A meadow is a field with grass and often wild flowers in it.

words.tr:
n. 日食；月食；黯然失色
v. 使失色
words.ex: We watched the solar eclipse last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚观看了日食。
words.en: An eclipse occurs when one celestial body moves into the shadow of another, temporarily obscuring it or cutting off its light.

words.ex: The rupture in the pipe caused a flood.
words.ex_cn: 管道的破裂导致了洪水。
words.en: A rupture is a severe injury in which an internal part of your body tears or bursts open, or the act of breaking or bursting something.

words.ex: Two events happen concurrently.
words.ex_cn: 两个事件同时发生。
words.en: Happening or existing at the same time.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.ex: He felt dismay when he saw the low grade.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到低分时，感到沮丧。
words.en: Dismay is a feeling of unhappiness and disappointment.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.ex: The army corps marched through the town.
words.ex_cn: 军队军团穿过城镇行进。
words.en: A corps is a military unit consisting of a large number of soldiers, typically organized for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
n. 名声；名誉；名望
v. 认为；以为
words.ex: He is of good repute in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他在镇上声誉很好。
words.en: The opinion generally held of someone or something; the state of being regarded in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 法西斯主义者
adj. 法西斯主义的
words.ex: He supports a fascist leader.
words.ex_cn: 他支持一位法西斯领导人。
words.en: A fascist is someone who supports or believes in fascism, a political system based on a very powerful leader, state control, and being extremely proud of country and race, and in which political opposition is not allowed.

words.ex: The government decided to deregulate the airline industry.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定解除对航空业的管制。
words.en: To remove regulations or controls from something, especially an industry or sector.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.ex: He used a pretext to leave the meeting early.
words.ex_cn: 他找了个借口提前离开了会议。
words.en: A pretext is a false reason that you give for doing something, usually something bad, in order to hide the real reason.

words.ex: The law will emancipate slaves.
words.ex_cn: 法律将解放奴隶。
words.en: To emancipate someone means to set them free from something that restricts their freedom to do what they want.

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: The two houses are adjacent to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两栋房子彼此相邻。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, it is next to it or adjoining it.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He hurt his thigh while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时伤了大腿。
words.en: The part of the human leg between the hip and the knee.

words.tr:
n. 掠夺物；掠夺；赃物
v. 掠夺；洗劫
words.ex: The pirates found loot on the sunken ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗们在沉船中找到了战利品。
words.en: Loot refers to goods stolen from a place, especially during a war or riot. It can also mean to steal goods from a place, especially during a war or riot.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.tr:
v. 猛扭；扭伤；挣脱
n. 扳手；扳钳；（离别的）痛苦
words.ex: He wrenched the door open with all his strength.
words.ex_cn: 他用尽全力猛扭门，把它打开了。
words.en: A wrench is a tool used for gripping and turning nuts, bolts, pipes, etc. It can also refer to a sudden violent twist or pull, or a feeling of sadness or distress caused by separation.

words.tr:
v. 拖；拉；拖运；
n. 拖；拉；拖运；
words.ex: He hauled the heavy box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他把沉重的箱子拖过了房间。
words.en: To haul something means to pull it or carry it with a lot of effort.

words.ex: The people started an uprising against the unfair rules.
words.ex_cn: 人们因不公平的规则而发动了起义。
words.en: An uprising is a violent act of opposition by many people in one area against those who are in power there.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的过去式；
words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: Past tense of give, which means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.

words.tr:
adj. 持不同意见的
n. 意见不同的人；持不同政见者
words.ex: The dissident spoke out against the government.
words.ex_cn: 这位持不同政见者公开反对政府。
words.en: A dissident is a person who opposes official policy, especially that of an authoritarian state.

words.tr: n. 一回；一次；发作；拳击比赛
words.ex: He had a bout of coughing last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳了一阵子。
words.en: A bout of something is a short period of time during which it occurs a lot or is especially severe.

words.ex: He used a voucher to buy a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张代金券买了一杯咖啡。
words.en: A voucher is a piece of paper that can be used instead of money to pay for something, or that allows you to pay less than the usual price for something.

words.ex: The metallic spoon felt cold in her hand.
words.ex_cn: 金属勺子在她手中感觉很冷。
words.en: Metallic means relating to or resembling metal or metals.

words.ex: He gave her a gift to appease her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他送她一份礼物来平息她的怒气。
words.en: If you try to appease someone, you try to stop them from being angry by giving them what they want.

words.ex: He eats cauliflower with dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐都吃花椰菜。
words.en: Cauliflower is a large, round, white vegetable that is eaten cooked or raw.

words.tr: n. 阐述者；拥护者；代表者；指数
words.ex: He is the exponent of modern education reform.
words.ex_cn: 他是现代教育改革的阐述者。
words.en: An exponent is someone who supports and explains a particular idea, theory, or system, or a symbol that shows how many times a number is to be multiplied by itself.

words.tr: v. 把…强加给；使遭受；使承受
words.ex: The storm inflicted heavy damage on the village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给村庄造成了严重破坏。
words.en: If you inflict something unpleasant on someone, you make them suffer it.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: He nodded in a blink.
words.ex_cn: 他一眨眼就点了点头。
words.en: To shut and open the eyes quickly, typically involuntarily.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: The phone vibrates when it receives a call.
words.ex_cn: 当手机收到电话时，它会震动。
words.en: To vibrate means to move rapidly to and fro or up and down; to oscillate.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: The latent talent in the child became clear after years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子潜在的才能在多年练习后显现出来。
words.en: Latent is used to describe something which is hidden and not obvious at the moment, but which may develop further in the future.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.ex: Henceforth, I will wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 从今以后，我会早起。
words.en: From this time on; from now on.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of chocolate pudding after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一碗巧克力布丁。
words.en: A pudding is a cooked sweet dish made with flour, fat, and eggs, and usually served hot.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.ex: His denial of the mistake made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他否认错误，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: A denial is a statement that something is not true or does not exist.

words.tr: adj. 自发的；自然产生的；
words.ex: The children gave a spontaneous cheer.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自发地欢呼起来。
words.en: Something that is spontaneous is not planned but happens or is done because of a sudden impulse or natural feeling.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.ex: The castle endured a long siege during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡在战争中经历了长期的围攻。
words.en: A siege is a military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building, cutting off essential supplies, with the aim of compelling those inside to surrender.

words.tr: adj. 宽厚的；仁慈的；不严格的；
words.ex: The teacher was lenient with students who were late.
words.ex_cn: 老师对迟到的学生很宽厚。
words.en: If you are lenient with someone, you are not strict in the way you treat them, especially when they have done something wrong.

words.ex: She wore an elegant dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条优雅的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe a person or thing as elegant, you mean that they are pleasing and graceful in appearance or style.

words.ex: His answer was erroneous because he added wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案是错误的，因为他加错了。
words.en: If you describe someone's beliefs or opinions as erroneous, you mean that they are incorrect and based on false information.

words.tr: adj. 疯狂的；精神失常的；精神错乱的
words.ex: He thinks it's insane to drive without a license.
words.ex_cn: 他认为无证驾驶是疯狂的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as insane, you mean that they are very foolish or crazy.

words.ex: The medicine helps inhibit pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于抑制疼痛。
words.en: If something inhibits an event or process, it prevents it or slows it down.

words.ex: The bird glide smoothly over the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在湖面上滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly and continuously along, as if without effort or resistance.

words.ex: The old tree has a stout trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干。
words.en: Someone who is stout is rather fat or heavy.

words.ex: The court will indict him for theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院将对他提起盗窃指控。
words.en: If someone is indicted for a crime, they are officially charged with it.

words.ex: He looked up the word in an encyclopedia.
words.ex_cn: 他从百科全书中查找这个词。
words.en: An encyclopedia is a book or set of books giving information on many subjects or on many aspects of one subject and typically arranged alphabetically.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.tr:
adj. 偏袒的；党派性的
n. 强烈支持者；党羽；游击队员
words.ex: He gave a partisan answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了偏袒的回答。
words.en: A partisan is a strong supporter of a party, cause, or person. It can also refer to a member of an armed group formed to fight secretly against an occupying force.

words.ex: The volcano released sulfur into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山向空气中释放了硫。
words.en: Sulfur is a pale yellow, odorless, brittle solid, which is insoluble in water but soluble in carbon disulfide.

words.ex: Children play in the plaza after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在广场上玩耍。
words.en: A plaza is an open public space that is found in the heart of a city or town. It is often surrounded by buildings and may include shops, restaurants, and other amenities.

words.ex: The liner sailed across the ocean with hundreds of passengers.
words.ex_cn: 这艘邮轮载着数百名乘客横渡了海洋。
words.en: A liner is a large ship that carries passengers on regular journeys.

words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.tr: v. 开创；为（某人）举行就职典礼；为…举行开幕仪式
words.ex: The president will inaugurate the new hospital next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将于下周为新医院举行揭幕仪式。
words.en: If you inaugurate a new system, service, or project, you start it or introduce it officially.

words.ex: He sat with good posture at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在书桌前，姿势端正。
words.en: Your posture is the way in which you hold your body when you are standing or sitting.

words.ex: The jockey rode the horse to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 骑师骑马赢得了比赛。
words.en: A jockey is someone who rides horses in races, especially as a profession.

words.ex: The bishop moves diagonally across the chessboard.
words.ex_cn: 象在国际象棋棋盘上斜着走。
words.en: A bishop is a senior member of the Christian clergy, usually in charge of a diocese and empowered to confer holy orders.

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.tr: v. 驱散；消散；浪费；挥霍
words.ex: The fog will dissipate by noon.
words.ex_cn: 雾将在中午前消散。
words.en: If something dissipates or is dissipated, it becomes less or becomes less strong until it disappears or goes away completely.

words.tr:
n. 橡皮水管；塑料水管
v. 用软管输水
words.ex: He uses a hose to water the plants.
words.ex_cn: 他用软管给植物浇水。
words.en: A hose is a flexible tube conveying water, used chiefly in firefighting and gardening.

words.tr: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪；使无效；使停止活动
words.ex: The accident paralyzed his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他的腿瘫痪了。
words.en: If someone is paralyzed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

words.ex: The disease afflicted many people in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病使村子里许多人遭受痛苦。
words.en: If you are afflicted by pain, illness, or misfortune, it causes you great suffering and distress.

words.ex: You must abide by the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: If you can't abide someone or something, you dislike them very much.

words.ex: The violent news appalls her.
words.ex_cn: 这起暴力新闻令她震惊。
words.en: to fill with horror or dismay; shock deeply

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.tr:
adj. 光滑的；圆滑的；熟练的；华而不实的
n. 浮油层；光滑之处
v. 使平滑
words.ex: The ice on the road was slick.
words.ex_cn: 路上的冰很光滑。
words.en: If something is slick, it is done smoothly and efficiently, often in a way that is intended to be impressive.

words.ex: Reading books is his favorite pastime.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: A pastime is something that you do because you enjoy it or are interested in it, rather than as a job.

words.tr: v. 由于保险丝烧断而电路不通；熔接；结合；
words.ex: The light went out because the fuse blew.
words.ex_cn: 灯灭了，因为保险丝烧断了。
words.en: A fuse is a safety device consisting of a strip of wire that melts and breaks an electric circuit if the current exceeds a safe level. As a verb, it means to join or blend to form a single entity.

words.ex: The boy showed defiance by refusing to follow the rules.
words.ex_cn: 男孩通过拒绝遵守规则来表现违抗。
words.en: Defiance is behaviour or an attitude which shows that you are not willing to obey someone or something.

words.ex: The government will mobilize troops to help after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 政府将调动军队在地震后提供帮助。
words.en: If you mobilize a group of people, or if they mobilize, they prepare to take action, especially in a military context.

words.ex: The witch flew on a broomstick at night.
words.ex_cn: 巫婆在夜里骑着扫帚飞行。
words.en: A woman who is believed to have magical powers and who uses them to harm or help other people.

words.tr: adj. 眼的；视觉的；光学的
words.ex: He wears optic glasses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴光学眼镜以便看得清楚。
words.en: Relating to the eye or vision.

words.ex: He works on a large ranch in Texas.
words.ex_cn: 他在德克萨斯州的一个大牧场工作。
words.en: A ranch is a large farm, especially in the western United States and Canada, where cattle or other animals are bred and raised.

words.ex: Salt is soluble in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐可以溶于水。
words.en: A substance that is soluble can be dissolved in a liquid.

words.ex: Farmers spread lime on the soil to make it less acidic.
words.ex_cn: 农民在土壤上撒石灰以降低其酸性。
words.en: Lime is a white substance obtained by heating limestone, used in making cement and in farming to improve soil. It is also a small green fruit that is similar to a lemon.

words.tr:
adj. 哑的；无声的
n. 哑巴；沉默的人
v. 减弱…的声音
words.ex: He stayed mute during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间保持沉默。
words.en: If someone is mute, they are unable to speak.

words.ex: He went to the consulate to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去领事馆办理签证。
words.en: A consulate is the place where a consul works, which is an official who is sent by their country to live in a foreign city in order to help other citizens from their own country and to represent their country's commercial interests.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fort during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中保卫了堡垒。
words.en: A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

words.tr:
v. （突然）烧旺；闪耀；突然爆发；张开；加剧
n. 旺火；亮光
words.ex: The fire began to flare up suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火突然燃了起来。
words.en: A flare is a sudden bright light or flame, or a sudden increase in something such as activity or trouble.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.ex: He tried to agitate the workers to strike.
words.ex_cn: 他试图鼓动工人罢工。
words.en: If you agitate something, you stir it up or shake it. If something agitates you, it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.ex: The church teaches its doctrine to all members.
words.ex_cn: 教会向所有成员传授它的教义。
words.en: A doctrine is a set of beliefs or principles that are taught or accepted by a particular group, especially in religion or politics.

words.ex: They sailed on a yacht during their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们在假期乘游艇航行。
words.en: A yacht is a medium-sized sailboat used for racing or cruising.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.tr:
n. 殉道者；殉教者；烈士
v. 处死；折磨
words.ex: He became a martyr for freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他为自由而成为烈士。
words.en: A martyr is someone who is killed or made to suffer greatly because of their religious or political beliefs, and is admired and respected by people who share those beliefs.

words.tr:
v. 弯腰；俯身；卑屈；俯冲
n. 弯腰；屈背；屈服；俯冲
words.ex: He must stoop to enter the small door.
words.ex_cn: 他必须弯腰才能进入那扇小门。
words.en: If someone stoops, they bend their body forwards and downwards.

words.ex: The score was nil at the end of the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束时分数为零。
words.en: Nothing or none; used to indicate the absence of something.

words.tr:
v. 使腐败；
adj. 腐败的；
words.ex: The official was corrupt by taking bribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员因收受贿赂而腐败。
words.en: If someone is corrupt, they do things that are dishonest or illegal in order to gain money or power.

words.ex: He paid the first installment last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周支付了第一期分期付款。
words.en: An installment is one of the amounts, usually equal, into which a debt is divided for payment at stated intervals over a fixed period.

words.ex: The judge will arbitrate the dispute between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 法官将调解这两个邻居之间的纠纷。
words.en: To arbitrate means to officially settle a dispute by making a decision that both sides accept.

words.tr:
n. 后备人员；备用物品
adj. 备用的；应急的
words.ex: He is on standby for the emergency call.
words.ex_cn: 他正在待命，等待紧急电话。
words.en: A standby is something or someone that is ready to be used if needed, especially in an emergency.

words.tr:
adj. 迟钝的；弱智的；智力发育迟缓的
v. 延迟；弄慢；使耽误；“retard”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was called retarded by some kids at school.
words.ex_cn: 他被学校的一些孩子叫做迟钝的。
words.en: Less advanced in mental, physical, or social development than is usual for one's age.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.ex: The proximate cause of the accident was bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 事故的直接原因是恶劣天气。
words.en: If something is proximate, it is nearest in space, time, or relationship.

words.tr: adj. 悲惨的；不幸的；难过的；恶劣的
words.ex: He felt wretched after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wretched, you mean that they are in a very bad or unfortunate situation.

words.ex: The missionary taught children in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 这位传教士在一个小村庄里教孩子们。
words.en: A missionary is a person who is sent to a foreign country to spread a religion.

words.ex: The riddle perplexed the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜语让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

words.ex: He walked up the staircase to his room.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去了他的房间。
words.en: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building, often including the supporting structure, the handrails, and sometimes the landings at the top and bottom.

words.ex: His conceit makes him ignore others' advice.
words.ex_cn: 他的自负让他忽视别人的建议。
words.en: An excessively favorable opinion of one's own abilities or worth; vanity.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.tr:
n. 脸红；羞愧
v. 泛红；羞愧
words.ex: He felt shy and got a blush when she praised him.
words.ex_cn: 当他被她夸奖时，他感到害羞，脸红了。
words.en: If you blush, your face turns red because you are embarrassed or ashamed.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handbook for the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了一本科学项目的手册。
words.en: A handbook is a type of reference work, or other collection of instructions, that is intended to provide ready reference.

words.ex: The workers used a hoist to lift the heavy beams.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用吊升机械吊起沉重的梁。
words.en: To hoist something means to lift or pull it up to a higher position, usually using some kind of equipment such as a crane or pulley.

words.ex: The map has an indicative arrow to show the way.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图上有一个指示方向的箭头。
words.en: If one thing is indicative of another, it suggests what the other thing is likely to be.

words.tr:
n. 钩；扣；紧握；紧抱
v. 抱紧；握紧；扣紧
words.ex: The necklace has a gold clasp.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链有一个金色的钩。
words.en: A clasp is a small device that fastens something, or the act of holding someone or something tightly.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: He shoved his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他挤过人群。
words.en: To push someone or something in a rough or careless way.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: If someone resides somewhere, they live there or are staying there.

words.tr:
n. 厚木底皮鞋；木屐
v. 堵塞；妨碍
words.ex: She wore wooden clogs to work in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着厚木底皮鞋去花园干活。
words.en: If something clogs a hole or place, it blocks it so that nothing can pass through.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；姿态；镇静
v. 使平衡；保持（某种姿势）
words.ex: The dancer maintained her poise on one foot.
words.ex_cn: 舞者单脚保持平衡。
words.en: If someone has poise, they are calm, dignified, and self-controlled.

words.tr:
n. 箔；陪衬物
v. 阻止；挫败
words.ex: He used foil to wrap the sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他用锡纸包住了三明治。
words.en: To prevent someone from succeeding in their plans or intentions, especially by doing something clever or unexpected.

words.ex: They rejoice when the sun comes out.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳出来时，他们欢呼。
words.en: To feel or show great joy or delight.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.tr: n. （医院或监狱中的）同宿者；监犯
words.ex: The inmate shared his cell with two others.
words.ex_cn: 这名囚犯和另外两个人共用一间牢房。
words.en: A person who is confined in a prison, hospital, or other institution.

words.ex: Bears hibernate in winter to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 熊在冬天冬眠以保存能量。
words.en: To spend the winter in a dormant state.

words.ex: She dried the herb to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她晒干了这种药草来泡茶。
words.en: A plant or a part of a plant that is used for its medicinal, savory, or aromatic qualities.

words.ex: The two teams are in a deadlock over the budget.
words.ex_cn: 两个团队在预算上陷入了僵局。
words.en: A deadlock is a situation in which no progress can be made or no agreement is reached, especially because of a disagreement between two or more parties.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.tr: adj. 古怪的；难以解释的
words.ex: He is queer and proud of who he is.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，并为自己是谁而自豪。
words.en: Queer is used to describe something that is strange or unusual, or someone who is homosexual.

words.ex: The Senate will ratify the treaty next week.
words.ex_cn: 参议院下周将批准这项条约。
words.en: If a country or organization ratifies a treaty or agreement, they make it official by giving their formal approval to it, usually by signing it or voting for it.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.tr:
n. 侧面；侧翼；胁腹
v. 在…侧面（有）
words.ex: The soldiers moved to the flank to avoid the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们移动到侧翼以避开敌人。
words.en: The side of something, especially a part of the body between the ribs and the hip; to be situated on each side of or on one side of (something).

words.ex: I looked up his phone number in the directory.
words.ex_cn: 我在姓名地址录里查了他的电话号码。
words.en: A directory is a book or list which gives names, addresses, and other information about people or organizations.

words.ex: He sings gospel music every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日唱福音音乐。
words.en: The teachings of Jesus and the apostles, especially as contained in the first four books of the New Testament, known as the Gospels.

words.ex: He has a masculine voice and strong build.
words.ex_cn: 他声音低沉，身材强壮。
words.en: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.ex: The company hired an expert to do an audit.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位专家进行审计。
words.en: An audit is an official examination of the accounts of a business or organization to check that they are accurate and correct.

words.ex: He felt deep misery after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: Misery is a state of great unhappiness and emotional distress.

words.ex: The plaintiff sued the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 原告起诉该公司要求赔偿。
words.en: A plaintiff is a person who brings a case against another in a court of law.

words.ex: She bought a new perfume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一瓶新香水。
words.en: A perfume is a pleasant-smelling liquid which people put on their skin to make themselves smell nice.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.tr: adj. 亲切的；和蔼的；仁慈的
words.ex: She was gracious and thanked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她很友善，感谢了每一个人。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially someone you think is superior to you, as gracious, you mean that they are very well-mannered and pleasant.

words.ex: He used an abbreviation for 'company' in his note.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记中用了'company'的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

words.ex: Ancient warfare used swords and shields.
words.ex_cn: 古代战争使用剑和盾。
words.en: Warfare is the activity of fighting a war.

words.ex: He became addicted to heroin last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年对海洛因上瘾了。
words.en: Heroin is a highly addictive drug derived from morphine, which is itself obtained from the opium poppy. It is used illicitly for its euphoric effects.

words.tr:
n. 禁止贸易令；禁运
v. 禁止…的贸易；禁运
words.ex: The country placed an embargo on imported goods.
words.ex_cn: 该国对进口商品实施了禁运。
words.en: An embargo is an official order to stop trade with another country.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.tr:
n. 烈火；火焰；闪耀
v. 闪耀；熊熊燃烧；发亮光
words.ex: The fire began to blaze in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 火在森林里开始猛烈燃烧。
words.en: A blaze is a very large or fiercely burning fire that is difficult to control.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: He bought a paperback novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本平装小说。
words.en: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover, as opposed to a hardback, which has a hard cover.

words.ex: He used a clamp to hold the wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹具把木头固定在一起。
words.en: A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together. As a verb, to clamp means to hold or fasten something tightly.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；攫住
n. 紧抓；离合器；一窝雏；一小群；紧要关头
words.ex: He clutched the rope tightly when he slipped.
words.ex_cn: 当他滑倒时，他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To clutch something means to hold it tightly, usually because you are afraid or anxious. In a vehicle, the clutch is a pedal that you press with your foot to change gears.

words.ex: He is a scientist of great renown.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位享有盛誉的科学家。
words.en: Renown is the state of being known and talked about by many people because of your achievements, qualities, or actions.

words.tr: adj. 世俗的；非宗教的；长期的
words.ex: He lives a secular life without religion.
words.ex_cn: 他过着没有宗教的世俗生活。
words.en: Secular activities, attitudes, or things have no connection with religion.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.ex: He sent a letter of condolence to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友寄了一封慰问信。
words.en: An expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of a death.

words.tr: v. 熄灭；平息；抑制（欲望）；用水冷却
words.ex: He quenched the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水熄灭了火。
words.en: To satisfy one's thirst or to extinguish a fire or to suppress a feeling or desire.

words.tr:
n. 精巧动作；军事演习；花招
v. （熟练地）移动；操控；算计
words.ex: The dancer's maneuver was breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 舞者的精巧动作令人叹为观止。
words.en: A maneuver is a movement or series of movements requiring skill and care.

words.tr:
n. 首次露面；初次登场
v. 初次登场；首次推出
words.ex: He made his debut on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在舞台上首次登台。
words.en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

words.ex: He won the chess tournament last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周赢得了国际象棋锦标赛。
words.en: A tournament is a competition in which players who win a match continue to play further matches in the competition until just one person or team is left.

words.ex: The court will prosecute him for theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院将因盗窃罪起诉他。
words.en: To prosecute means to institute legal proceedings against someone or to carry on a legal action against a defendant in a court of law. It also means to continue with or carry on an activity or enterprise.

words.ex: The committee will convene tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 委员会明天将召开会议。
words.en: If someone convenes a meeting or conference, they arrange for it to take place. They can also be said to convene when they meet.

words.tr: adj. 公开的；明显的；公然的
words.ex: His anger was overt and hard to miss.
words.ex_cn: 他的愤怒是明显的，很难忽视。
words.en: An overt action or attitude is done or shown in an open and obvious way.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息；倒抽气
n. 喘气；喘息
words.ex: He gasped when he saw the big snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到那条大蛇时，他倒吸了一口冷气。
words.en: To take a short, quick breath through the mouth, especially because of surprise, pain, or shock.

words.ex: The company streamlined its hiring process.
words.ex_cn: 公司简化了招聘流程。
words.en: To make something such as a business, organization, or process work more effectively by making it simpler or more efficient.

words.ex: The two rooms adjoin each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个房间彼此相邻。
words.en: If one room, place, or object adjoins another, they are next to each other.

words.ex: They had a discord about the movie ending.
words.ex_cn: 他们对电影的结局有分歧。
words.en: Disagreement or strife between people or groups.

words.tr: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；悲观的；
words.ex: He gave a cynical smile when they talked about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 当他们谈到诚实时，他露出了愤世嫉俗的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as cynical, you mean they believe that people always act selfishly.

words.ex: The boy defied his parents by staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为熬夜不回家而违抗了父母。
words.en: If you defy someone or something, you refuse to obey them or you do something that they do not allow.

words.ex: The warrior threw a spear at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 战士向敌人投掷了一支矛。
words.en: A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp point at one end, used for thrusting or throwing.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.ex: The clergy prayed in the church every morning.
words.ex_cn: 神职人员每天早上在教堂祈祷。
words.en: The clergy are the official leaders of religious activities in certain religions, especially in Christianity.

words.tr: adj. 有希望的；有前途的； v. 承诺；答应；“promise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The young boy is a promising student.
words.ex_cn: 这个小男孩是个有希望的学生。
words.en: Showing signs of future success or achievement.

words.tr: n. 船坞；造船厂；修船厂；船舶修理所
words.ex: The shipyard builds large boats for the navy.
words.ex_cn: 造船厂为海军建造大型船只。
words.en: A shipyard is a place where ships are built or repaired.

words.tr:
n. 遇难船只；残骸；
v. 破坏；毁坏；
words.ex: The wreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘遇难船只沉在海底。
words.en: If something such as a ship or a plane is wrecked, it is damaged so much that it cannot be repaired or it is completely destroyed.

words.ex: He will defer his trip until next month.
words.ex_cn: 他将把旅行推迟到下个月。
words.en: If you defer an event or action, you arrange for it to happen at a later date, rather than immediately or at the previously planned time.

words.tr:
n. 之字形；锯齿形；
adj. 之字形的；曲折的；锯齿形的；
words.ex: The road makes a zigzag up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这条路沿着山呈之字形向上延伸。
words.en: A zigzag is a line that has a series of angles in it, like a continuous series of 'W's. It can also describe a path or route that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

words.tr: n. 派系；派系斗争；内讧
words.ex: The faction argued loudly about the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 这个派别就新规定激烈争论。
words.en: A faction is a group of people within a larger group who have different opinions and beliefs from the rest of the group.

words.tr:
n. 拨浪鼓；嘎嘎声；咔嗒声
v. 发出格格声；使紧张不安；喋喋不休
words.ex: The baby laughed while shaking the rattle.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝摇着拨浪鼓笑了。
words.en: If something rattles or if you rattle it, it makes short sharp knocking sounds as it moves or shakes.

words.ex: He kneaded the dough for bread.
words.ex_cn: 他揉了做面包的生面团。
words.en: Dough is a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid, used for baking into bread or pastry. It can also informally refer to money.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The momentous decision changed his life.
words.ex_cn: 这个重要的决定改变了他的一生。
words.en: If you refer to a decision, event, or change as momentous, you mean that it is very important, often because of the effects that it will have in the future.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
