words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.tr: adj. 压倒的；无法抗拒的；势不可挡的； v. “overwhelm”的现在分词；
words.ex: The crowd's cheers were overwhelming.
words.ex_cn: 人群的欢呼声压倒了一切。
words.en: If something is overwhelming, it affects you very strongly, and you do not know how to deal with it.

words.tr: adj. 全世界的；四海一家的；
words.ex: This city has a cosmopolitan population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着来自世界各地的人口。
words.en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.ex: He showed the utmost care when handling the fragile glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在处理易碎的玻璃时表现出了最大的小心。
words.en: The greatest or highest degree of something.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: He overheard them talking about the party.
words.ex_cn: 他无意中听到他们在谈论派对。
words.en: To overhear is to hear what someone is saying without them knowing that you are listening.

words.ex: The robbers took a hostage during the bank robbery.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪在银行抢劫时抓了一名人质。
words.en: A hostage is someone who has been captured by a person or organization and who may be killed or injured if people do not do what that person or organization demands.

words.ex: The scientist created a cocktail of chemicals for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 科学家为实验配制了一种化学混合物。
words.en: A cocktail is a mixed drink typically made with a combination of alcoholic beverages and other ingredients such as fruit juices, syrups, or cream.

words.tr: v. 公开承认；宣布；声称
words.ex: He professes to love music.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己热爱音乐。
words.en: If you profess to do or have something, you claim that you do it or have it.

words.ex: The superintendent of the school is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主管非常严格。
words.en: A superintendent is a person who is in charge of a particular department or activity, especially within a school, housing project, or police force.

words.ex: Oil helps to lubricate the engine parts.
words.ex_cn: 油有助于润滑发动机部件。
words.en: To apply a substance such as oil or grease to (something) in order to minimize friction and allow smooth movement.

words.ex: His converse was the opposite of what he said earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他的相反言论与他之前说的话相反。
words.en: To engage in conversation; to talk informally with someone.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: The midwife helped the baby come out safely.
words.ex_cn: 助产士帮助婴儿安全出生。
words.en: A midwife is a person, usually a woman, who is trained to help women during childbirth.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: He is an ardent supporter of environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 他是环境保护的热心支持者。
words.en: An ardent person has strong feelings or enthusiasm for something.

words.ex: The beetle crawls on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 甲虫在叶子上爬行。
words.en: A beetle is an insect with a hard shell-like back. Beetles are a group of insects which have a large number of species.

words.ex: He held a pistol in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一把手枪。
words.en: A pistol is a small gun.

words.ex: The mother won custody of her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲获得了孩子的监护权。
words.en: Custody is the legal right or duty to care for someone or something, especially a child after its parents have separated or died.

words.ex: He loves studying botany in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在花园里学习植物学。
words.en: Botany is the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: The knight rode a horse and wore shiny armor.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑着马，穿着闪亮的盔甲。
words.en: In the Middle Ages, a knight was a man of high social rank who had a duty to fight for his king. Knights are often depicted as noble warriors on horseback.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: The antonym of 'hot' is 'cold'.
words.ex_cn: ‘hot’的反义词是‘cold’。
words.en: An antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.tr: adj. 精美的；细腻的；强烈的
words.ex: She wore an exquisite dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精美的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is exquisite is extremely beautiful or pleasant, especially in a delicate or refined way.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.tr: adj. 歇斯底里的；异常激动的
words.ex: She became hysterical when she lost her wallet.
words.ex_cn: 她丢了钱包时变得歇斯底里。
words.en: If someone is hysterical, they are in a state of uncontrolled excitement, anger, or panic, often because of a shock or a very upsetting experience.

words.tr:
v. 握紧；捏紧；咬牙切齿
n. 抓紧；咬紧；抓紧用具
words.ex: He clenched his fist when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时握紧了拳头。
words.en: To close or hold something very tightly, especially in a determined or angry way.

words.ex: The bird uses its beak to eat seeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟用它的喙吃种子。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part of a bird's mouth, used for picking up and eating food.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——金钱和时间

words.tr: phrase. 紧张的预算；资金有限的情况
words.ex: They live on a tight budget to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他们靠紧缩的预算生活以存钱。
words.en: A financial situation where money is limited and must be spent carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 用来打发时间的事物；填充时间的活动
words.ex: He used a crossword as a time filler during the bus ride.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上用填字游戏打发时间。
words.en: An activity or period used to occupy time without a primary purpose.

words.w: a waste of time and resources
words.tr: phrase. 浪费时间和资源的行为或情况
words.uk: ə weɪst əv taɪm ænd rɪˈzɔːsɪz
words.us: ə weɪst əv taɪm ænd rɪˈzɔːrsɪz
words.ex: Running this old machine is a waste of time and resources.
words.ex_cn: 运行这台旧机器是浪费时间和资源。
words.en: An activity or effort that consumes time and resources without producing any useful result.

words.tr: phrase. 沉溺于；放纵自己于（某种情感或行为）
words.ex: He abandon himself to sadness after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 他在失去之后沉溺于悲伤。
words.en: To give oneself over completely to a feeling, emotion, or influence.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.ex: He is obsessed with video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于电子游戏。
words.en: To be completely preoccupied with a particular thought or feeling, often to an unhealthy degree.

words.ex: The project is short of funds to continue.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目缺乏资金以继续进行。
words.en: To have less of something than is needed or desired.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面浪费的；对……挥霍的
words.ex: He is wasteful with water.
words.ex_cn: 他浪费水。
words.en: To use resources carelessly or inefficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 挥霍金钱；浪费钱财
words.ex: He is burning money on expensive cars.
words.ex_cn: 他正花大笔钱买昂贵的汽车。
words.en: To spend a large amount of money on something that seems unnecessary or wasteful.

words.ex: The new phone is too costly for me.
words.ex_cn: 这部新手机对我来说太贵了。
words.en: If you say that something is costly, you mean that it costs a lot of money, often more than you would want to pay.

words.tr: phrase. 停止学习；中断学业
words.ex: He decided to discontinue his studying because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他决定停止学习，因为他累了。
words.en: To stop attending school or university before completing a course.

words.tr: phrase. 经济负担；指个人、家庭、组织或社会在经济上承受的压力或成本
words.ex: The disease caused a heavy economic burden on the family.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病给这个家庭带来了沉重的经济负担。
words.en: An economic burden refers to the financial strain or load that is placed on an individual, family, or organization due to various economic factors such as taxes, healthcare costs, or other financial obligations.

words.tr: phrase. 经济困难；经济困境
words.ex: Many families face economic difficulty during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在经济衰退期间面临经济困难。
words.en: Economic difficulty refers to a situation where a country, organization, or individual faces financial problems or challenges, often leading to reduced economic activity, increased unemployment, or decreased living standards.

words.ex: He expended all his money on food.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都花在了食物上。
words.en: To expend something, especially energy, time, or money, means to use it or spend it.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.tr: phrase. 财政援助；经济资助
words.ex: He got financial aid to pay for his books.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了经济援助来支付书本费用。
words.en: Financial aid refers to funding intended to help students pay education expenses including tuition, books, and living costs for study at post-secondary educational institutions.

words.ex: He feels financial strain because he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他因为丢了工作而感到经济压力。
words.en: Financial strain refers to the pressure or stress that arises from financial difficulties or burdens.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: The ad induced him to buy the product.
words.ex_cn: 这则广告诱使他购买了该产品。
words.en: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: He is jobless after losing his factory work.
words.ex_cn: 他失去工厂工作后失业了。
words.en: If someone is jobless, they do not have a job, although they would like one.

words.tr: phrase. 有限的公共资金；有限的政府拨款
words.ex: The school has limited public funds for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校用于购买新书的公共资金有限。
words.en: Limited public funds refer to a restricted amount of money available to the government or public institutions for spending on services, projects, or investments.

words.tr: adj. 误导的； v. “mislead”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ad is misleading because it shows fake results.
words.ex_cn: 这个广告是误导的，因为它展示了虚假的结果。
words.en: If you describe something as misleading, you mean that it gives you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: Video games are money-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 电子游戏很费钱。
words.en: Requiring a lot of money to be spent.

words.tr: adj. 向钱看的；拜金主义的
words.ex: He is money-oriented and always works for high pay.
words.ex_cn: 他很看重金钱，总是为了高薪工作。
words.en: Focused on or motivated by financial gain.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: The cat occupies the sofa all day.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫整天占据着沙发。
words.en: If people or things occupy a place, they are in it or fill it.

words.ex: He went overdrawn on his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他的银行账户透支了。
words.en: An overdraft occurs when money is withdrawn from a bank account and the available balance goes below zero.

words.tr: phrase. 消磨时间；打发时间
words.ex: He likes to pass time by reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢通过读书来消磨时间。
words.en: To spend time in a particular way, especially when waiting for something or when you have nothing else to do.

words.tr: phrase. 贫困线；最低生活标准线
words.ex: Many families live below the poverty line.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭生活在贫困线以下。
words.en: The poverty line is the minimum level of income deemed adequate in a particular country.

words.tr: adj. 为贫穷所困恼的，为贫穷所困扰的；非常贫穷的
words.ex: The poverty-stricken family needs food and water.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫困的家庭需要食物和水。
words.en: Extremely poor.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.tr: phrase. 抵制诱惑；抗拒诱惑；忍住诱惑
words.ex: He tries to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他努力抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: To resist the temptation means to stop yourself from doing something that you want to do but know you should not.

words.ex: He tries to restrain his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength.

words.tr: phrase. 陶醉于；沉迷于；尽情享受；因…而兴高采烈
words.ex: They revel in the sunshine on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他们尽情享受海滩上的阳光。
words.en: To take great pleasure or delight in something.

words.tr: adj. 有益的；值得的； v. “reward”的现在分词；
words.ex: Volunteering is a rewarding experience.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务是一种有益的经历。
words.en: Providing satisfaction or gratification; beneficial.

words.ex: He shows self control when he stays calm under pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他在压力下保持冷静，表现出自制力。
words.en: The ability to control one's impulses, emotions, and behaviors to achieve long-term goals.

words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.ex: He often skips classes to play video games.
words.ex_cn: 他经常逃课去打电子游戏。
words.en: To intentionally not attend classes that one is supposed to attend.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 把钱白白浪费掉；把钱扔到空中（比喻毫无回报地花钱）
words.ex: He throws money into thin air on useless things.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱浪费在无用的东西上。
words.en: To spend money on something that is unlikely to bring any return or benefit, essentially wasting it.

words.ex: Doing homework by hand is time-consuming.
words.ex_cn: 手写作业很耗时。
words.en: If you describe an activity as time-consuming, you mean that it takes a lot of time to do.

words.tr: phrase. 沉溺于（某种情绪或状态）；放纵自己于（尤指负面事物）
words.ex: He is wallowing in sadness after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 他在这段感情破裂后沉溺于悲伤中。
words.en: If you say that someone wallows in an unpleasant situation, you are criticizing them for being deliberately unhappy.

words.tr: phrase. 消磨时间；打发时间
words.ex: He likes to play cards to while away the time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢打牌来消磨时间。
words.en: To spend time in a relaxed or leisurely way, especially when waiting for something or when there is nothing else to do.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——教育和健康

words.ex: The government decided to abolish the old law.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定废除这项旧法律。
words.en: If someone in authority abolishes a system or practice, they formally put an end to it.

words.ex: The abolishment of the law made people happier.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律的废止让人们更开心了。
words.en: The act of formally ending or stopping something, such as a system, practice, or institution.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The teacher gave an authoritative answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个权威性的回答。
words.en: If something is authoritative, it is respected and accepted as true or correct because it comes from a reliable source.

words.ex: The outcome of the experiment will be determined by the accuracy of the measurements.
words.ex_cn: v. 实验的结果将由测量的准确性决定。
words.en: to be decided or influenced by something

words.tr: phrase. 被注册参加；被录取入（课程、学校等）
words.ex: She was enrolled in the university last year.
words.ex_cn: 她去年被这所大学录取了。
words.en: To be officially registered or accepted as a participant in a course, program, or institution.

words.tr: phrase. 对身体造成伤害的；对物理结构有损害的
words.ex_cn: 过度的运动可能对身体造成伤害。
words.en: To cause harm or injury to the body.

words.ex: He attended a prestigious business school to further his career in management.
words.ex_cn: 他上了一所著名的商学院，以进一步发展他的管理事业。
words.en: A business school is a university-level institution that confers degrees in business administration or management. Such a school can also be known as school of management, school of business administration, or, colloquially, b-school or biz school.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: This substance is known to be cancer-causing.
words.ex_cn: 这种物质被认为是致癌的。
words.en: Capable of causing cancer.

words.ex: He has a chronic cough that lasts for months.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个持续数月的慢性咳嗽。
words.en: A chronic illness or condition lasts for a long time and cannot be cured, but it can usually be controlled.

words.ex: The teacher gave a comprehensive review before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前给了一个全面的复习。
words.en: Something that is comprehensive includes everything that is needed or relevant.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.ex: She buys convenience food for dinner because she is tired.
words.ex_cn: 她因为累了，所以买即食食品当晚餐。
words.en: Convenience food refers to food that is commercially prepared and designed for ease of consumption, often requiring minimal preparation by the consumer.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: He got a demerit for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而被扣分。
words.en: A demerit is a fault or disadvantage.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.tr: phrase. 个性的发展；人格的形成过程
words.ex: The child's development of personality takes years.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的个性发展需要多年时间。
words.en: The process by which an individual's character, traits, and identity are formed and evolve over time.

words.ex: The doctor can diagnose the illness quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生能很快诊断出这种病。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: The company plans to diversify its products.
words.ex_cn: 公司计划使产品多样化。
words.en: To diversify means to make or become more varied or different. It often refers to the process of a company or individual expanding their range of products or activities to reduce risk or to explore new opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人的健康造成损害
words.ex: Smoking can do harm to one's health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会对一个人的健康有害。
words.en: To cause damage or negative effects to someone's physical or mental well-being.

words.ex: He began to doubt the reliability of the information he had been given.
words.ex_cn: 他开始怀疑所获得信息的可靠性。
words.en: To question the dependability or trustworthiness of something or someone.

words.ex: The museum displays ancient artifacts from the Forbidden City.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了来自故宫的古代文物。
words.en: A mixture used to stuff poultry, especially duck, typically made from breadcrumbs, herbs, and other ingredients.

words.tr: phrase. 教育机构；教育组织
words.ex: The educational institution is committed to fostering academic excellence.
words.ex_cn: 这所教育机构致力于培养学术卓越。
words.en: An educational institution is a place where people of different ages gain an education, including preschools, childcare, elementary schools, and universities.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.tr: n. 入会；入学 ；登记；注册；加入人数
words.ex: His enrollment in the club was approved last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周被批准加入该俱乐部。
words.en: The act of officially joining a course, school, etc., or the number of people who do this.

words.tr: phrase. 入学考试；入学测验
words.ex: The entrance examination is a crucial step in the application process.
words.ex_cn: 入学考试是申请过程中的关键一步。
words.en: An entrance examination is a test that students take in order to be admitted to a school or university.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.tr: phrase. 应试教育；以考试为导向的教育体系
words.ex: Examination-oriented education emphasizes rote memorization over critical thinking.
words.ex_cn: 应试教育强调死记硬背，而非批判性思维。
words.en: A type of education system that focuses mainly on preparing students for examinations, often at the expense of a broader educational experience.

words.ex: The examiner asked the student a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 考官问了学生一个难题。
words.en: An examiner is a person who checks something carefully in order to see if it is correct or satisfactory, or who gives people a test to see what they know or can do.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: The movie was fairly interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影相当地有趣。
words.en: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree.

words.ex: After running for an hour, he felt fatigue.
words.ex_cn: 跑了一个小时后，他感到疲乏。
words.en: A feeling of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He wants to go to graduate school after college.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学毕业后读研究生院。
words.en: A graduate school is a school that awards advanced academic degrees (such as master's and doctoral degrees) with the general requirement that students must have earned a previous undergraduate (bachelor's) degree.

words.ex: Smoking is harmful to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is harmful has a bad effect on something else, especially on a person's health.

words.tr: phrase. 卫生保健；健康护理
words.ex: He works in health care as a nurse.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名护士从事医疗工作。
words.en: Health care refers to the organized provision of medical care to individuals or a community.

words.ex: She eats healthful food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Conducive to good health; health-giving.

words.tr: phrase. 高脂肪和高热量的
words.ex: This fast food is high fat and calorie.
words.ex_cn: 这种快餐是高脂肪和高热量的。
words.en: Describes food that contains a large amount of fat and calories, which can lead to weight gain if consumed in excess.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: He ate too much and had indigestion.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，导致消化不良。
words.en: Indigestion is pain or discomfort in your stomach, usually after eating, which is caused by difficulty in digesting food.

words.tr: phrase. 传染病；由病原体引起并可在人与人之间传播的疾病
words.ex: The spread of infectious disease can be controlled through vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 通过接种疫苗可以控制传染病的传播。
words.en: An infectious disease is a disease caused by the invasion of the body by pathogenic microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, parasites, or fungi, which can be spread, directly or indirectly, from one person to another.

words.ex: The company wants to innovate its production process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司想改革它的生产流程。
words.en: To innovate means to introduce changes and new ideas in the way something is done or made.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 强化培训课程；密集训练班
words.ex: The company offered an intensive training course to quickly upskill its employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供了一个密集培训课程，以快速提升员工的技能。
words.en: An intensive training course is a series of lessons or lectures designed to teach a particular skill or subject in a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 初级学院；两年制专科学校；大专
words.ex: She attended a junior college before transferring to a university.
words.ex_cn: 她在转学到大学之前就读于一所大专。
words.en: A junior college is a two-year post-secondary educational institution offering courses leading to an associate degree or certificates.

words.tr: phrase. 垃圾食品；无营养食品
words.ex: He eats junk food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都吃垃圾食品。
words.en: Food that is unhealthy but is quick and easy to eat.

words.ex: He wants to go to law school.
words.ex_cn: 他想上法学院。
words.en: A law school is an institution where students study law to become lawyers or legal professionals.

words.ex: The child has malnutrition from not eating enough food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子因为吃不够饭而营养不良。
words.en: Malnutrition is a condition that results from eating a diet in which certain nutrients are lacking, in excess (too high in intake), or in the wrong proportions.

words.ex: He spent eight years in medical school.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学院学习了八年。
words.en: A medical school is a tertiary educational institution, or part of such an institution, that teaches medicine, and awards a professional degree for physicians and surgeons.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: The smoke from the factory is noxious.
words.ex_cn: 工厂的烟雾是有害的。
words.en: Something that is noxious is harmful or poisonous.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.tr: phrase. 油腻的食物；含油量高的食物
words.ex: Eating too much oily food can lead to health problems.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多油腻食物会导致健康问题。
words.en: Food that contains a lot of oil or fat, making it greasy and heavy.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr: phrase. 实际能力；实践能力；可操作的能力
words.ex: His practical capability in problem-solving was evident during the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在项目中解决问题的实践能力显而易见。
words.en: The ability to perform tasks effectively in real-world situations.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.ex: The school focuses on quality-oriented education for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校致力于为所有学生提供以质量为导向的教育。
words.en: An educational approach that focuses on the comprehensive development of students' abilities and qualities, rather than solely on academic performance.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The reliability of this car is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的可靠性很高。
words.en: The quality of being trustworthy or consistent in performance.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.tr: adj. 刻板的；坚硬的；严格的；
words.ex: He has a rigid attitude toward rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的态度很刻板。
words.en: not able to be changed or adapted; not able to be bent or moved; stiff

words.tr: phrase. 设定的时间；约定的时间
words.ex: We set time for the meeting at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们把会议时间定在下午3点。
words.en: To arrange or fix a specific time for an event or action.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr: phrase. 测试技术；用于评估或检验系统、产品或理论的方法与手段
words.ex: The course covers various testing techniques used in software development.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了软件开发中使用的各种测试技术。
words.en: Testing techniques refer to the methods and procedures used to evaluate the functionality, reliability, and performance of a product or system.

words.ex: She was nervous about her thesis defence, but she performed well.
words.ex_cn: 她对论文答辩感到紧张，但表现很好。
words.en: Thesis defence is the formal presentation and defense of a thesis or dissertation, typically required for the completion of a degree.

words.ex: He threw away the old book.
words.ex_cn: 他扔掉了那本旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something that is no longer useful or wanted; to waste an opportunity or advantage.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumor in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumor is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumors, something disrupts this cycle. Tumor cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumor continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate student at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate student is a student in a university or college who has not yet received a first degree.

words.ex: The weather was unfavorable for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐不利。
words.en: If conditions or circumstances are unfavorable, they make it difficult for something to happen or exist.

words.tr: phrase. 不健康的竞争；有害的竞争
words.ex: The company's strategy led to unhealthy competition among employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司的策略导致了员工之间不健康的竞争。
words.en: Competition that is harmful or damaging to the participants, often because it is too intense or conducted in an unfair manner.

words.tr: v. （使）统一；“unify”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 统一的；
words.ex: The two schools unified their programs last year.
words.ex_cn: 这两所学校去年统一了它们的课程。
words.en: Made into or caused to form a single unit or entity.

words.tr: adj. 不公平的；非正义的
words.ex: The judge made an unjust decision.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了一个不公正的决定。
words.en: If you describe an action, system, or law as unjust, you think that it treats a person or group badly in a way that they do not deserve.

words.ex: He was utterly surprised by the news.
words.ex_cn: 他全然没想到这个消息。
words.en: completely or totally

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.tr: phrase. 职业学校；技术学校
words.ex: He went to a vocational school to learn car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所职业学校学习修车。
words.en: A vocational school is an educational institution designed to provide vocational education or technical skills required to perform the tasks of a particular and specific job.

words.ex: He felt weariness after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天后感到疲惫。
words.en: A feeling of being extremely tired, either physically or mentally.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——人才和智力

words.tr: n. 一位有学问的人；学者
words.ex: He is a learned person who knows many old books.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个博学的人，懂很多古书。
words.en: A person who has acquired much knowledge through study and experience.

words.tr: phrase. 表达能力；表达的才能或技巧
words.ex: His ability of expression helps him explain ideas clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他的表达能力帮助他清晰地解释想法。
words.en: The capacity to convey thoughts and feelings effectively.

words.ex: He is adept at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: Someone who is adept at something is very skilled at it.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The brightness of the sun makes it hard to look.
words.ex_cn: 阳光太亮了，很难直视。
words.en: Brightness is the quality of being bright, which can refer to the intensity of light or the quality of being intelligent or lively.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长数学。
words.en: To be exceptionally good at or proficient in an activity or subject.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr: v. 经历；体验；“experience”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有经验的；
words.ex: He experienced a sudden storm while hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时经历了一场突如其来的暴风雨。
words.en: Someone who is experienced has knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity because they have done it for a long time.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: The movie was fantastic!
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极好！
words.en: If you describe something as fantastic, you are emphasizing that you think it is very good or that you like it a lot.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.ex: He bought a high-quality shirt for the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他为面试买了一件高质量的衬衫。
words.en: Of very good quality; excellent.

words.ex: His idealism drives him to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的理想主义驱使他帮助穷人。
words.en: Idealism is the belief that your ideals can be achieved, often when this does not seem likely to others.

words.tr: adj. 不合逻辑的；不合理的
words.ex: It is illogical to say the sun is not real.
words.ex_cn: 说太阳不存在是不合逻辑的。
words.en: If you describe an action, feeling, or belief as illogical, you are critical of it because you think that it does not result from a logical and ordered way of thinking.

words.ex: The honesty in her character is an inherence.
words.ex_cn: 她性格中的诚实是一种内在特质。
words.en: The fact or state of being inherent in something; intrinsic nature.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: His intellect helps him solve difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他的智力帮助他解决难题。
words.en: The ability to understand and think in a logical way about things.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.tr: adj. 度量小的；心胸狭窄的；有偏见的
words.ex: He is narrow-minded and refuses to listen to others.
words.ex_cn: 他思想狭隘，拒绝听取他人的意见。
words.en: If you describe someone as narrow-minded, you are criticizing them because they are unwilling to consider new ideas or other people's opinions.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.tr: phrase. 充分发挥；使…得到极大运用；把…运用到极致
words.ex: The coach put his skills into great play during the final match.
words.ex_cn: 教练在决赛中充分发挥了他的技能。
words.en: To utilize or showcase something to its fullest potential or advantage.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: phrase. 生存能力；存活能力
words.ex: The fish has great survival ability in dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 这种鱼在脏水中具有很强的生存能力。
words.en: The capacity of an organism or a species to remain alive or continue to exist, especially under adverse environmental conditions.

words.ex: He is a talented singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有才能的歌手。
words.en: Someone who is talented has a natural ability to do something well.

words.tr: phrase. 思维模式；思考方式
words.ex: His thinking pattern is very logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的思维方式非常有逻辑。
words.en: A habitual way of thinking that influences how an individual perceives and responds to situations.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——工作和生活

words.tr: n. 工作狂；沉迷于工作的人
words.ex: He is a work addict who never takes days off.
words.ex_cn: 他是个工作狂，从不休假。
words.en: A person who is excessively devoted to work, often to the detriment of their health, relationships, or personal life.

words.tr: phrase. 一个办公室的位置或办公地点
words.ex: The company has an office location in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个位于纽约的办公地点。
words.en: A specific physical place where business or administrative work is conducted.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: He spends hours on commuting and travel every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天花数小时在通勤和旅行上。
words.en: The act of traveling regularly between one's home and place of work or study.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr: phrase. 性价比较高的；本轻利厚的
words.ex: This bike is cost effective for daily travel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车用于日常出行很划算。
words.en: Something that is cost effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: Her mother gave her encouragement before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 考试前，她妈妈给了她鼓励。
words.en: Encouragement is the act of giving someone support, confidence, or hope.

words.tr: phrase. 额外的费用；附加开支
words.ex: He paid extra expenses for the hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 他为酒店房间支付了额外费用。
words.en: Additional costs that are not included in the original budget or estimate.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.ex: Ideally, we should finish the project by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 理想地，我们应该在周五前完成这个项目。
words.en: In an ideal or perfect way; in a way that would be best in an ideal world.

words.tr: phrase. 提升个人技能；提高个人能力
words.ex: He wants to improve personal skills by reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过读书来提升个人技能。
words.en: To enhance one's abilities, knowledge, or competencies through practice and learning.

words.tr: v. 用某物激励某人；用某事物激发某人的灵感
words.ex: The teacher inspired the students with her passion for science.
words.ex_cn: 老师用她对科学的热爱激励了学生们。
words.en: To fill someone with the urge or ability to do or feel something, especially something creative or positive.

words.ex: He wears pajamas to bed every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上穿睡衣睡觉。
words.en: Pajamas are loose-fitting clothes worn for sleeping, consisting of trousers and a jacket.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: Her words were prompting him to try again.
words.ex_cn: 她的话激励他再次尝试。
words.en: The action of saying something to persuade, encourage, or remind someone to do or say something.

words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.ex: The traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The rush hour is one of the periods of the day when most people are travelling to or from work.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr: n. 技能短缺；人才紧缺
words.ex: There is a skill shortage in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 科技行业存在技能短缺。
words.en: A situation where there are not enough people with the necessary skills to fill available jobs in a particular industry or sector.

words.tr: phrase. 使振作精神；鼓舞士气
words.ex: Her friends tried to spirit her up after she failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 她在考试失败后，朋友们努力让她振作起来。
words.en: To make someone feel more cheerful, confident, or determined.

words.tr: phrase. 满足个人需求；符合个人需要
words.ex: This app can suit personal needs.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用可以满足个人需求。
words.en: To be appropriate or acceptable for someone's personal requirements or desires.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

words.ex: He wants to switch jobs next month.
words.ex_cn: 他想下个月换工作。
words.en: To change from one job to another.

words.tr: phrase. 交通堵塞；交通拥挤
words.ex: The city has too much traffic congestion during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市在高峰时段有严重的交通拥堵。
words.en: A situation in which there is too much traffic and movement is made very slow or stopped.

words.tr: phrase. 随着……的到来；随着……的出现
words.ex: With the advent of smartphones, people use maps more often.
words.ex_cn: 随着智能手机的出现，人们更经常使用地图。
words.en: Indicates the time when something new starts or becomes available.

words.tr: phrase. 工作服；职业装；用于工作的衣物
words.ex: He puts on his work clothes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上穿上工作服。
words.en: Clothes worn for work, especially manual or industrial work.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——文化和传统

words.ex: The aboriginal people live in the forests of Australia.
words.ex_cn: 土著居民生活在澳大利亚的森林里。
words.en: An aboriginal person or thing is one that has been in a country or region from the earliest known times or from before the arrival of colonists.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术价值；指某件艺术作品在美学、创意或文化方面所具有的重要性和意义
words.ex: The artistic value of this painting is recognized worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的艺术价值被全世界认可。
words.en: The importance or worth of something in terms of its contribution to the arts, often evaluated based on its creativity, originality, and aesthetic appeal.

words.tr: phrase. 被传承下来；被世代相传
words.ex: This tradition has been passed down through generations.
words.ex_cn: 这一传统已经代代相传。
words.en: To be transmitted or inherited from one generation to the next.

words.tr: adj. 著名的； v. 庆祝；“celebrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a celebrated painter in China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在中国著名的画家。
words.en: A celebrated person or thing is famous and much admired.

words.tr: v. 珍爱；爱惜；怀念；怀有（感情）；抱有（希望）
words.ex: I cherish the time I spend with my family.
words.ex_cn: 我珍惜与家人共度的时光。
words.en: If you cherish something, you care for it lovingly and protect it carefully.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr: phrase. 文化的摇篮；文明的发源地
words.ex: Egypt is known as the cradle of culture.
words.ex_cn: 埃及被称为文化的摇篮。
words.en: A place where a particular culture or civilization started and developed.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: He shares his cultural background with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学们分享自己的文化背景。
words.en: The cultural background refers to the customs, beliefs, and social norms that are characteristic of a particular society or group.

words.tr: phrase. 文化机构；指从事文化传承、教育或艺术推广的组织，如博物馆、图书馆、美术馆等
words.ex: The museum is a cultural institution.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆是一个文化机构。
words.en: A cultural institution is an organization that is involved in the preservation, promotion, and dissemination of culture, such as museums, libraries, and theaters.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: She made an embroidery of a flower on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上绣了一朵花。
words.en: Embroidery is the craft of decorating fabric or other materials using a needle to apply thread or yarn. It may also incorporate other materials such as pearls, beads, quills, and sequins.

words.ex: The museum is dedicated to showcasing folk art from various cultures.
words.ex_cn: 该博物馆致力于展示来自不同文化的民间艺术。
words.en: Folk art encompasses art produced from an indigenous culture or by peasants or other laboring tradespeople. In contrast to fine art, folk art is primarily utilitarian and decorative rather than purely aesthetic.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 文化的全球化；指不同文化在全球范围内相互交流、融合和传播的过程
words.ex: The globalization of culture has led to a blending of traditions from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 文化全球化导致了不同国家传统的融合。
words.en: The process by which cultural experiences and expressions become standardized and shared across the world, leading to a more interconnected global community.

words.ex: His speech was great and profound.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲伟大而深刻。
words.en: Extremely significant, important, or having deep meaning and impact.

words.tr: phrase. 具有历史价值的文物；历史遗迹
words.ex: The historic relics in the museum provide a glimpse into the past.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆中的历史遗迹让人们得以一窥过去。
words.en: Historic relics refer to objects, buildings, or sites that have historical significance and are preserved for their cultural or historical value.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.tr: phrase. 语言消亡；语言灭绝（指一种语言不再有任何母语者或使用者，最终完全消失的现象）
words.ex: Many people worry about language extinction because it can cause loss of culture.
words.ex_cn: 许多人担心语言灭绝，因为它可能导致文化流失。
words.en: Language extinction refers to the process by which a language loses its last native speakers, leading to its disappearance from use.

words.tr: phrase. 语言流失；语言丧失（指由于社会、政治、教育等因素导致某种语言不再被使用或传承的现象）
words.ex: Language loss is a significant issue for preserving cultural diversity.
words.ex_cn: 语言丧失是保护文化多样性的一个重要问题。
words.en: Language loss refers to the process or condition where a language is no longer spoken by a community or an individual, often due to factors such as assimilation, migration, or the dominance of another language.

words.tr: phrase. 语言保护；语言保存（指通过记录、教育、政策等手段防止语言灭绝的活动）
words.ex: Language preservation efforts are crucial for maintaining cultural diversity.
words.ex_cn: 语言保护的努力对于维护文化多样性至关重要。
words.en: The act of keeping a language from extinction or decline, especially in a community where it is at risk of being lost.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.tr: phrase. 少数民族；少数族群
words.ex: Minority people deserve equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体应享有平等权利。
words.en: A group of people who are numerically smaller than the majority in a given society or population.

words.tr: phrase. 母语；本国语；本族语
words.ex: He speaks his mother tongue at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家说他的母语。
words.en: The first language that a person learns to speak as a child; a person's native language.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: The fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstruction is something that blocks a road, passage, or entrance, or the act of blocking something.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.tr: adj. 思想开放的；能接受新思想的
words.ex: He is open-minded about new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他对新想法持开放态度。
words.en: Willing to consider new ideas; unprejudiced.

words.ex: He loves to watch opera on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看歌剧。
words.en: An opera is a dramatic work in one or more acts, set to music for singers and instrumentalists.

words.tr: phrase. 过时的；不再流行的；落伍的
words.ex: Those shoes are out of fashion now.
words.ex_cn: 那些鞋子现在不流行了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or popular.

words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or current; obsolete.

words.tr: phrase. 名胜古迹；旅游景点；名胜
words.ex: We visited many places of interest during our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在旅行中参观了许多名胜。
words.en: Places of interest refer to locations that are popular or significant for their cultural, historical, or natural features, attracting tourists and visitors.

words.ex: She is the quintessence of grace.
words.ex_cn: 她是优雅的典范。
words.en: The quintessence of something is the most perfect or typical example of it.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.tr: adj. 壮观的；辉煌的；极好的；
words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was splendid.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落非常壮观。
words.en: If you say that something is splendid, you mean that it is very good.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.ex: He takes pride in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他以帮助别人为荣。
words.en: To feel a sense of satisfaction or pleasure in one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions, or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.tr: phrase. 传统文化；指世代相传的风俗、信仰、艺术、价值观等构成的社会文化体系
words.ex: He loves traditional culture from his country.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己国家的传统文化。
words.en: Traditional culture refers to the customs, beliefs, practices, and values that have been passed down from generation to generation within a community or society.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: The radio transmits music to listeners.
words.ex_cn: 收音机将音乐传递给听众。
words.en: To send or pass something from one person, place, or thing to another.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.tr: phrase. 部落传统；族群世代相传的习俗与文化
words.ex: The preservation of tribal traditions is crucial for maintaining cultural identity.
words.ex_cn: 保护部落传统对于维护文化身份至关重要。
words.en: Tribal traditions refer to the customs, beliefs, and practices that are passed down through generations within a tribe.

words.ex: The tribe lives in the forest and follows old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在森林里，遵循古老的传统。
words.en: A tribe is a social division in a traditional society consisting of families or communities linked by social, economic, religious, or blood ties, with a common culture and dialect, typically having a recognized leader.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——经济和发展

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: They decided to boycott foreign products to support local businesses.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定抵制外国产品以支持本地企业。
words.en: To refuse to buy or use goods from a foreign country as a form of protest or economic pressure.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He paid with cash for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金买了面包。
words.en: Money in the form of coins or banknotes, especially that which is immediately available.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.ex: Small commerce helps local towns grow.
words.ex_cn: 小商业有助于小镇的发展。
words.en: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things, especially on a large scale.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr: phrase. 宣告破产；声明无力偿还债务
words.ex: The company decided to declare bankruptcy after years of financial struggle.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的财务困境，公司决定宣布破产。
words.en: To officially state that a person or business cannot pay their debts and is thus bankrupt.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.ex: His weekly earnings are enough to pay rent.
words.ex_cn: 他的周收入足以支付房租。
words.en: Money obtained in return for labor or services.

words.tr: phrase. 经济负担；指个人、家庭、组织或社会在经济上承受的压力或成本
words.ex: The disease caused a heavy economic burden on the family.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病给这个家庭带来了沉重的经济负担。
words.en: An economic burden refers to the financial strain or load that is placed on an individual, family, or organization due to various economic factors such as taxes, healthcare costs, or other financial obligations.

words.tr: phrase. 经济不平等；收入或财富分配不均的现象
words.ex: Economic inequality has been a persistent problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 经济不平等一直是许多国家的一个持续问题。
words.en: Economic inequality refers to the unequal distribution of income and opportunity between different groups in society.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: The country faced a financial crisis last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了金融危机。
words.en: A financial crisis is a situation in which the value of financial institutions or assets drops rapidly.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种商品。
words.en: Goods are items that are made to be sold.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: The bank raised the interest rate last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The interest rate is the percentage of an amount of money which is paid for its use for a specified time, usually expressed as an annual percentage rate.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.tr: phrase. 被解雇的工人；下岗职工
words.ex: The laid-off worker struggled to find a new job in the competitive market.
words.ex_cn: 这位被解雇的工人在竞争激烈的市场中艰难地寻找新工作。
words.en: A laid-off worker is someone who has been dismissed from their job, typically because the company is reducing its workforce or ceasing operations.

words.ex: She stayed in a luxurious hotel with gold faucets.
words.ex_cn: 她住进了一家有金色水龙头的奢侈酒店。
words.en: Something that is luxurious is very comfortable and expensive, and often involves great pleasure or indulgence.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.tr: phrase. 大量生产；批量生产
words.ex: The factory uses mass production to make cars quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用大规模生产来快速制造汽车。
words.en: Mass production is the manufacture of large quantities of standardized products, often using assembly lines or automated technology.

words.tr: phrase. 流通手段；货币；流通媒介
words.ex: Money is the most common means of circulation in modern economies.
words.ex_cn: n. 在现代经济中，货币是最常见的流通手段。
words.en: The term 'means of circulation' refers to the medium through which goods and services are exchanged in an economy, typically money or other financial instruments.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.tr:
v. 提供；
n. 提供；提议；报价；
words.ex: He offers help to his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学提供帮助。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr: phrase. 私营企业；民营经济；自由企业制度
words.ex: Private enterprise plays a crucial role in economic growth.
words.ex_cn: 私营企业在经济增长中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: A private enterprise is a business or industry that is managed by independent companies or private individuals rather than by the state.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: He asked for a quotation for the new computer.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了新电脑的报价。
words.en: A quotation is a sentence or phrase taken from a book, poem, play, etc., which is repeated by someone else, or a statement of the current price of something.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.tr: n. 节约； v. 拯救；节省；保存；“save”的现在分词；
words.ex: His saving helped him buy a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他的节约帮他买了一辆新车。
words.en: Saving refers to the act of keeping money or other resources for future use, or the money that is saved.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.ex: The government subsidize small businesses to help them grow.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助小企业以帮助它们发展。
words.en: To subsidize something means to pay part of the cost of it, usually as a way of helping people or organizations that cannot afford to pay the full cost themselves.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.ex: The taxpayer paid his taxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 纳税人按时缴税了。
words.en: A taxpayer is a person or organization that pays taxes to the government.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr: n. 营业额；人员流动率；周转率；
words.ex: The store's turnover increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店上个月的营业额增加了。
words.en: The amount of money taken by a business in a particular period.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.ex: Our company managed to win the bid for the new highway construction project.
words.ex_cn: 我们公司成功中标了新的高速公路建设项目。
words.en: To win the bid means to be selected as the best or most suitable candidate for a project or contract, usually through a competitive process.

chapters.name: 写作实用表达——科技和进步

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
